summary: Full E2E validation of Faz 9 CP6 Global Announcement System (backend + frontend + SSE fan-out). All 9 pytest backend tests pass serially. Frontend admin CRUD, RBAC filtering, banner render, dismiss, ack, and real-time SSE delivery all work correctly. Cleaned up all PYTEST_ann_* rows after tests.

minor.issue: Tests fail when run in parallel (pytest-xdist default -n auto in pytest.ini) because both workers login as same 'serkan' user and second login triggers SESSION_KICKED single-session policy. Run with -n0 for reliable results, or scope xdist to loadfile / use unique test accounts. Not a functional bug — the announcement system itself is fine.

issues: Overdue tasks modal ('SÜRESİ GEÇMİŞ GÖREV') has no data-testid on its close X button and doesn't close on Escape, making it hard to interact with settings modal beneath during automated tests. Suggest adding data-testid='overdue-modal-close' and Escape key handler. Cosmetic — not a blocker.

test_results_detail.backend_pytest: 9/9 passed (test_announcements.py) — TestPublishRBAC (admin publish 200, employee 403), TestValidation (empty title/invalid severity/role-without-value all → 400), TestTargetingAndAck (role filtering, all-target ack idempotent), TestCrudAndStats (update, soft-delete, purge, stats).
test_results_detail.frontend_admin_flow: PASS — Settings modal opens via CustomEvent, DUYURULAR tab present (admin only), AnnouncementManager renders, YENİ DUYURU modal opens, form fields (title/message/target/severity) fill, YAYINLA publishes → row appears (data-testid=ann-row-<uuid>), Stats button reveals target_count=35, ack_count=1, ack_ratio=2.86%.
test_results_detail.frontend_rbac: PASS — DUYURULAR tab count=0 for ahmet (employee); admin-only gating works.
test_results_detail.frontend_banner_sse: PASS — After serkan published via API, ahmet's already-open tab rendered the AnnouncementBanner within 500ms via SSE (no polling). Title/message rendered, severity=critical showed red color, KRİTİK label.
test_results_detail.frontend_ack_flow: PASS — Critical + require_ack=true announcement shows ANLADIM button (not X). Clicking ack removes banner, backend stats confirm ack_count incremented to 1.
test_results_detail.frontend_dismiss_flow: PASS — Info+require_ack=false shows X (dismiss), clicking removes banner locally.
test_results_detail.cleanup: 2 PYTEST_ann_* announcements purged via DELETE /purge after tests.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Adjust pytest.ini or test_announcements.py to avoid xdist parallel session-kicking (e.g., use --dist loadfile or -n0 for this file, or set unique test users). This is a test-harness issue, not an application bug.
OPTIONAL: Add data-testid + Escape handler to Overdue tasks modal for better testability.
critical_code_review_comments: AnnouncementBanner + NotificationBell SSE re-broadcast pattern works reliably; latency <500ms from publish to render.
Backend RBAC and Pydantic validation correct; role/company target filtering enforced server-side.
Soft-delete vs hard-purge separation is clean; stats returns 404 after purge as expected.
Idempotent ack (already=true on second call) works as documented.
seed_data_creation: None persisted — all PYTEST_ann_* rows purged.

When running test_announcements.py locally, use `pytest backend/tests/test_announcements.py -n0` to avoid xdist parallel SESSION_KICKED false-positives. The overdue tasks modal blocks the settings modal on serkan's fresh sessions; close it by clicking near coordinates (950,158) or by adding a testid.
